correctness.rationale: On the orthonormal basis e_n=(n+1)^(-s/2)z^n, C_d e_n=sqrt(w_n)e_(dn) with w_n=((dn+1)/(n+1))^s. The selfcommutator is diagonal with k_0=0 and k_n=w_n-1_(d|n) w_(n/d). Writing a=d^s and b=-d^s s(1-1/d), the residual r_n=k_n-a 1_(d not dividing n) has tails b/n on nonmultiples and (1-d)b/n on multiples, both with O(n^-2) error. This proves compactness and Calkin essential spectrum {0,a}. Counting residue-class indices above modulus t gives 2|b|(1-1/d)/t, yielding the singular coefficient and exactly half to each sign; harmonic sums give logarithmic coefficients, weak-S1 but not S1, and S_p iff p>1. Exact telescoping of partial k_n sums leaves sum_(floor(N/d)<n<=N)(w_n-a), hence b log d. s=0 yields R=0 and sign of monotone weight ratios proves K inertia. Independent numerical sorted-diagonal checks gave j=500 normalized singular coefficients 0.994..0.999 for four real s/d pairs and shell-limit errors at or below roughly .0012; these are corroborations, not infinite proofs.
